name: Developer Experience and Extension Store
description: Productized extension lifecycle: scaffold, validate manifest, simulate authority, sandbox test, publish, review, install/update/revoke, store listing, compatibility matrix, capability receipts, and abuse reporting. Convergence point for VS Code extension, MCP tool, Electron extension, and Tribunus authority model.
objective: Build the extension store: scaffold, validate, publish, review, install, and revoke extensions with capability-scoped authority.
